questions.prompt: Which of these organs are part of the digestive system?
questions.fact: The liver makes bile, which the gallbladder stores and squeezes into the gut to break down fat.

questions.prompt: Which of these English words come from Arabic?
questions.fact: Algebra comes from al-jabr, a word in the title of a maths book written in Baghdad in the 800s.

questions.prompt: How many Oscars did the film Titanic win?
questions.fact: Eleven, a record it shares with Ben-Hur and The Return of the King.

questions.prompt: How long is the pitch at Wembley Stadium, in metres?
questions.fact: 105 m by 68 m, the size FIFA recommends for international matches.

questions.prompt: In Greek myth, Athena was the goddess of what?
questions.fact: Athens is named after her, and the Parthenon was built as her temple.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.hint: It is not the biggest city. It sits on the river between Ontario and Quebec.
questions.fact: Queen Victoria picked Ottawa in 1857, partly as a compromise between English and French speaking Canada.
